desc:
🚗 Welcome to Car For Sale, the ultimate car dealership experience on Roblox!

Browse a huge catalog of vehicles with rare finds, inspect their condition, negotiate prices, and build your dream collection. Run your own dealership, list cars on the cross-server Marketplace, and dominate the leaderboard!

🏆 Compete in the Exhibition Show, show off your rarest cars!
🔍 Inspect cars before you buy, condition affects the price!
📈 Watch the stock market to buy low and sell high
🪪 Unlock exclusive vehicles as your reputation grows
💰 Flip cars, grow your dealership, become the richest dealer on the server!

New cars spawn every cycle, don't miss the rare ones! ⭐
